title: A bruise is blood trapped under skin after small vessels leak
summary: MedlinePlus says a bruise is a mark from blood trapped under the skin when an injury breaks small vessels but not the skin.
body: MedlinePlus says a bruise is a mark on the skin caused by blood trapped under the surface. An injury crushes small blood vessels but does not break the skin. Those vessels break open and leak blood under the skin. The page says the mark is often painful and swollen, that most last about two weeks, and that the color shifts from reddish to bluish-purple and then greenish-yellow. Bone bruises are called the most serious kind on that page. This card says what the mark is. It does not give care steps for a particular person.
